title: シンザン記念の後に・栄冠へRUN

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle stands out at the Shinzan Kinen with a powerful run and demonstrates her mastery of sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With plenty of momentum to spare, her next step is to clear the main hurdle in the selection process—clinching the Best Sprinter award.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle enters the NHK Mile Cup—the race that decides the classic-year King of the Mile.
